title: selaginella sinensis
intro: Selaginella sinensis, commonly known as Spiny Spikemoss, is a type of evergreen, perennial plant that belongs to the family Selaginellaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and enhancing immune function. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella sinensis are attributed to its ability to scavenge free radicals, inhibit pro-inflammatory enzymes, and modulate immune responses, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Selaginella sinensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
